title: Convex
description: The reactive backend platform for full-stack TypeScript developers. Automatically syncs database state to your UI with live queries and zero cache management.
features: 100% end-to-end type safety between database tables, server queries, and React UI
Reactive live queries: React components automatically re-render when server data updates
Transactional ACID mutations with automatic optimistic UI updates
Built-in scheduled background cron jobs, actions, and file vector search
Local dev server with instant offline development and automatic schema migrations
pros: Completely eliminates state management libraries like React Query or Redux
Unmatched developer experience for React and Next.js applications
Generous developer tier with high operation allowances
cons: Proprietary backend engine architecture with limited custom database driver access
Requires embracing Convex's query paradigm rather than raw SQL
targetAudience: React, Next.js, and mobile developers who want seamless real-time syncing without managing websockets.
